items.title: Digital ownership records
items.description: Shares are entered in a shared digital ledger that is hard to alter quietly.

items.title: Transaction traceability
items.description: Each operation keeps its trail over time, so its history can be reviewed.

items.title: Smart contract execution
items.description: Programs that automatically apply pre-agreed conditions when they are met.

items.title: Public verification
items.description: Recorded transactions can be verified without relying on a single party.

blockchain.plain: Picture a shared notebook in which every operation is written down, and several parties hold a copy. Once a new page is added, it becomes hard to change earlier pages without the others noticing. That is the basic idea of a blockchain.
blockchain.disclaimer: Blockchain alone does not guarantee legal ownership, investment security or returns. Rights and obligations depend on the applicable legal framework and contracts.

faq.title: Answers to your main questions
faq.subtitle: General and cautious information. These answers are not investment advice.

items.a: Bunyane is an Algerian digital platform that aims to connect investors with real estate developers, providing an infrastructure to present projects, subscribe to their companies' shares and track operations. The current website is informational and is not an investment offer.

items.q: How can I take part in investing?
items.a: Once the platform opens, you will be able to review the projects presented, study their conditions and then subscribe following the applicable procedures and conditions. Participation depends on meeting the legal and regulatory requirements in force.

They are shares in a real estate project company whose subscription and related operations are recorded in a digital ledger. The shareholder's rights and obligations remain governed by law, the company's articles and the relevant contracts.

Shares and transactions are entered in a distributed digital ledger that allows the history of operations to be verified. This ledger does not by itself replace the legal requirements for proving ownership, which fall under the applicable legal framework.

No. Every investment involves risk: its value can fluctuate and an investor may lose part or all of their capital. Bunyane does not guarantee any profits or returns. Please study each opportunity carefully and consult a professional.

items.q: How can I track my investments?
items.a: The platform aims to let investors follow their contributions, their shares and the related operations from their personal account, once that service is available.

items.q: Can shares be transferred or sold?
items.a: Whether shares can be transferred or sold depends on the legal and contractual conditions that apply to each project. It may be restricted or unavailable in some cases. Review each project's conditions before subscribing.
